reviews.title: Delayed Unapproved Charges
reviews.text:
I am leaving this review to warn other users and to document my experience with this company’s billing practices.

I canceled my subscription with this service six months ago. Despite that cancellation, my account was charged without my authorization. When I discovered the charge, I contacted their billing department on multiple occasions to resolve the matter. I spoke directly with two representatives (James and Ashley)both of whom confirmed that no refund would be issued, despite having canceled well in advance of the charge.

I have since escalated this matter to my bank and filed a formal dispute. I have also submitted a complaint with the appropriate consumer protection agencies.

This is not a matter of misunderstanding, my subscription was canceled, my account was charged without consent, and the company has refused to make it right. Potential users should be aware of these billing practices before subscribing.

I do not leave negative reviews lightly, and I would have gladly updated this review had the company chosen to resolve the issue appropriately.

reviews.title: Be AWARE!!
reviews.text:
I signed up for Tattoo AI through a Facebook ad that led me to a “quiz” to find my perfect tattoo. At no point during that process was it clearly stated that I would be locked into a non-refundable purchase.

After signing up, I quickly realized it wasn’t what I expected and requested a refund. I was denied solely because I signed up through their website—which is the exact path their ad forces you to take.

This feels misleading and intentionally designed to get people to pay before they fully understand what they’re agreeing to. A clear refund policy should be shown upfront before any payment is taken.

I would not recommend this service based on my experience. Please be cautious before entering payment information.

reviews.title: Totally freezes
reviews.text: Tried to design a tattoo with the AI tattoo generator. It asked for further details but there was nowhere to type those details. The screen was just froze. I tried both closing the app and reopening and the conversation had vanished and I tried closing the chat but that just deletes it bringing you right back to square one! Totally buggy!!

reviews.title: Terrible App
reviews.text: This app is not capable of doing ANYTHING I asked for. If you ask for a photo to be turned into a tattoo, it quite literally looks like a photo of a stranger and it didn’t matter how many times I altered or changed the photo. My 1 year old came out looking like a 12 year old with no similarities. By far the absolute WORST app out there that I have seen this far.  Extremely disappointed. Difficult to cancel the subscription. Don’t waste your time and definitely do NOT waste your money! 🤦‍♀️

reviews.title: Pretty bad overall
reviews.text:
Full of bugs, can’t even type into the prompt box without it randomly deleting words and moving your cursor around for no reason. 
The AI doesn’t listen to what you want to create no matter what way you phrase it. 
After you select one of the generated tattoos you can fine tune it with more prompts, however whenever I do this the app just turns the tattoo into a photo, like a normal ai generated photo, it’s no longer a tattoo. 
Overall super disappointing, don’t waste your time or money.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: First of all- hitting people with a paywall before trying the app, especially when that involves a year subscription is ridiculous. Secondly , when I did get through and tried the AI create it failed miserably. It interpreted the word 5th as the word “Gut”.

reviews.title: Total junk
reviews.text: App doesn’t even understand or allow editing of basic text

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: Worst tattoo app I’ve used. Constantly says face not detected then says app under maintenance when I’m only trying to add a text to a tattoo. Please save your money.

reviews.title: Get at your own risk
reviews.text: I’d give it half a star TBH. Got this app and it was fine but then it was down for literal MONTHS. Couldn’t do anything. So now I just tried to use it and now it’s saying I’m exceeding my daily limit. Like hello? I just got back on. I paid for the yearly unlimited. Needless to say it was not worth it. I didn’t even get one good design out of it. My suggestion is do your own research and get the cheapest option before you splurge for the bigger subscriptions.

reviews.title: Disappointing, outdated, and completely unoriginal
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for the AI tattoo generator, but honestly, it’s terrible. Every “design” it spits out looks like it was pulled straight from some bargain-bin flash sheet in the 90s — flames, skulls, generic roses, tribal bands, you name it. There’s not a single original or creative concept in the bunch.
Even when I try to feed it a thoughtful, specific idea, it can’t seem to understand or visualize anything beyond its stale presets. It’s like it’s recycling the same tired old clip art over and over again, just with different filters.
If you’re hoping for something fresh, artistic, or even remotely personalized, don’t waste your time. This thing doesn’t design tattoos — it just regurgitates outdated clichés. Total letdown
